name: glutamate metabotropic receptor 1

function.text: GRM1 encodes metabotropic glutamate receptor 1. Annotated molecular activities include glutamate receptor activity and G protein-coupled receptor activity. It participates in locomotory behavior and chemical synaptic transmission.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 13 (autosomal recessive); spinocerebellar ataxia 44 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
